a_complete_workspace_to_document_underst: A complete workspace to document, understand and present your internship.

analyze_daily_and_cumulative_hours_work_: Analyze daily and cumulative hours, work categories, work modes, weekdays, mood, energy, focus and satisfaction.
cloud_accounts_include_confirmation_veri: Cloud accounts include confirmation, verification-email resend and password recovery flows.

data_heavy_pages_provide_search_periods_: Data-heavy pages provide search, periods, categories, states and sorting so the app stays efficient across months of data.

document_context_project_completed_work_: Document context, project, completed work, outcomes, learning, blockers, feedback, next steps and evidence.

from_the_workday_to_the_final_report_wit: From the workday to the final report, without re-entering the same information.

prepare_a_report_supervisor_review_or_po: Prepare a report, supervisor review or portfolio case study from data that is already structured.
produce_a_professional_summary_print_to_: Produce a professional summary, print to PDF and export JSON or CSV for backup or further analysis.
search_by_text_date_category_work_mode_m: Search by text, date, category, work mode, mood or sort order to find precise information quickly.
see_documented_days_missing_periods_and_: See documented days, missing periods and your current pace without scanning a long list.

switch_languages_without_returning_home_: Switch languages without returning home: the route, page and search parameters are preserved.

use_filters_and_charts_to_spot_trends_in: Use filters and charts to spot trends, incomplete periods and skills actually used.
metadata_description: Discover Practicora features for documenting internships, tracking hours, analyzing skills and preparing professional reports.
